# paths.py

[简体中文](paths.zh.md) ｜ **English** ｜ [← Back to README](../../README.en.md)

Paths and connectors: path, polyline, tables, arrows and wave lines.

This file contains a single class, `PathMixin`, a mixin that `board/__init__.py` composes into `MagicPen`.

---

PathMixin - paths and connectors: path, polyline, tables, arrows, wave lines.

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| `path(fill_color=Color.TRANS…, stroke_color=Color.BLACK, stroke_width=1, stroke_style=None, stroke_cap=None, stroke_join=None, fill_rule=None, dash_offset=None, blend_mode=None, filter=None, opacity=1.0, id_=None, **extra)` | Start a path and return a PathElement; then chain move_to / line_to / cubic_to and friends. |
